title: Maximize Pair Strength Using GCD
summary: Given an integer array nums, select a unique pair of distinct indices i and j.
statement: Given an integer array nums, select a unique pair of distinct indices i and j. The strength of this pair is calculated as (nums[i] × nums[j])/(gcd(nums[i], nums[j])^2), where gcd denotes the greatest common divisor. Return the maximum strength that can be achieved for any such pair.
constraints: Their strength is nums[i]*nums[j] divided by gcd(nums[i],nums[j]) squared.
hints: Enumerate each unordered index pair once.
Divide the product by the square of that gcd using integer arithmetic.

tests.explanation: The pair three and five is coprime and has strength fifteen.
Their gcd is two, so the strength is sixty divided by four, or fifteen.
